verdict.rationale: Caveman's own docs describe a feature that suggests fixes, each with an estimated saving. Alongside per-call, per-agent and per-team spend data, this implies suggestions drawn from the user's own usage. Pre-written TL;DR summaries of changes add some insight-style output. The evidence is a single thin line per capability, does not say the suggestions are AI-generated, and has no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights over user data, the breadth of data analyzed, how suggestions are produced and surfaced, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Every fix it suggests says what it would save you.
Look up any call your agents made, and what it cost.
Written before you open it: a one-line TL;DR, the one call that is yours, then each change as before, after and why.
